title: 'The Child' Is Coming to Netflix on 27 November, Following Its Cinema Premiere on 13 November
summary: A story about loss, memory, and how a family learns to keep living
body_markdown:
Entertainment


07 September 2026


Global


Spain


Link copied to clipboard


[Download the photos](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/5608b870-0725-4287-a7fa-b2a9ed8ebcdf)


[Download the teaser poster](https://assetshare.netflixstudios.com/9310e0f2-543f-442d-bf53-852fb264cd9b)


Netflix has today announced the release date for


The child


, the new film written and directed by


Mariano Barroso


(


Éxtasis


,


Todas las mujeres


,


La línea invisible


) and starring Goya Award winners


Belén Cuesta


(


La trinchera infinita


,


La casa de papel


) and


Karra Elejalde


(


8 apellidos vascos


,


Mientras dure la guerra


).


El niño


will hit cinemas on


13 November


, ahead of its


Netflix release on 27 November


.


Based on the novel by


Fernando Aramburu


, and produced by


Mariano Barroso


and


Rafael Portela


(Umea Films),


The Child


tells the story of Mariaje (


Belén Cuesta


) and Nicasio (


Karra Elejalde


), the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. The tragedy shocked the local community and the whole of Spain, changing their lives forever. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for —and find— their own unique way to overcome their loss.


With


The child


,


Mariano Barroso


returns to directing, following


Todas las mujeres


– the film for which he won, alongside


Alejandro Hernández


, the Goya for Best Adapted Screenplay – and series such as


El día de mañana


and


La línea invisible


.


The cast is rounded off by


Pep Ambròs


(


El cuerpo en llamas


,


El olivo


),


Raquel Ferri


(


Los renglones torcidos de Dios


),


Joan Solé


(


Nos vemos en otra vida


), and the young actor


Alex Infantes


(


El cuco de cristal


).


Paola Vallejo


Senior Publicity Manager
